title: Step 10 - recall: creating a bookmark from memory
intro: Write step 9's `create.go` again, from memory. Your
`Bookmark`, `Store` and routes are already in the module.
It needs the method `create` on `*api`, the handler for
`POST /bookmarks`. It decodes the request body into a
struct holding only `url` and `title`, and answers 400
- the body is not valid JSON, or has any other field
- `url` is missing, or is not an absolute http or https
Otherwise it stores a `Bookmark` with `created` set to
`time.Now()` and answers 201 with the stored bookmark
Press `<F6>` to submit: `go vet` and the step's hidden
tests decide. If they fail, fix it and submit again.
